entries.50a5d5cee8d20724: It has its head office in Sapporo, Hokkaido, and is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. It has three consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was 171.
entries.8ea069f576a1d49a: It is a company that builds up recurring stock-type revenue from continuous billing, with automated monitoring and operation of systems through its proprietary platform 'puzzle' and licensing of its IoT engine 'NEQTO' as its pillars.
entries.8f86d81b5150eb95: This business provides system monitoring and operation and services for IoT, centered on technology (A&A) that automatically detects and controls servers and IoT devices connected to the internet. It is a single segment, and sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥3,625 million. There are 3 consolidated subsidiaries: Mobicomm Inc., JIG-SAW US, INC. and JIG-SAW CA, INC. The equity-method affiliate is SBI JIG-SAW Modernizations Co., Ltd. (49% of voting rights held), a joint venture for the financial industry. This is the only business for which sales are disclosed independently, and no breakdown amounts are disclosed.
entries.92c93aecc42c4659: That 'puzzle' and 'NEQTO' were developed in-house, that NEQTO's key technologies have been patented in Japan and overseas, and that regular employee engineers respond at three control center sites are printed under [Business Overview]. That monthly billing revenue has shown record-high positive growth for 44 consecutive quarters since listing is printed under [Management's Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows].
entries.93aad2de24c5d18c: Monthly fees for management services and initial fees at introduction
entries.96e3f29c244a313d: Its distinguishing feature is that, drawing on foundational technologies for OS development and communication control, it has the automated operations platform 'puzzle', which it developed in-house, and the IoT engine 'NEQTO', whose key technologies are patented in Japan and overseas, and that regular employee engineers provide support 24 hours a day, 365 days a year from its in-house control centers in Sapporo and Toronto. It runs a stock-type model based on monthly billing, and monthly billing revenue has set a record high for 44 consecutive quarters since listing.

entries.a8ebbfb7234428e7: That system management is the main business, that JIG-SAW US, INC. has started a NEQTO.ai dashboard service, and that a development project for an autopilot standard machine for road rollers is being advanced jointly with Sakai Heavy Industries, Ltd. are printed under [Management's Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows].
entries.bbd51c66f863a2b0: OEM licensing and subscription revenue from the IoT engine
entries.bfb231765aaa5f01: This is a service providing the IoT-OEM license, which licenses the IoT engine "NEQTO" for embedded devices, and the IoT global data control, which controls data from device groups in North America, Europe and Asia.
entries.c1a9b72b00b4237f: This service uses the in-house developed robot-type automated operations platform "puzzle" to automatically monitor and operate physical servers, cloud servers, IoT devices and network equipment. It also includes "Safing", which automatically monitors and diagnoses cloud security, and "JIG-SAW PRIME", a comprehensive cloud support service covering billing agency, deployment support and operation and maintenance. It is provided 24 hours a day, 365 days a year from 2 sites in Sapporo and a control center in Toronto, North America. This is a category for which amounts are not disclosed independently.
entries.cd8e4b6eac5dc5d5: It aims to become one of the central companies of the digital universe era by connecting all kinds of equipment, devices, substances, organisms, cells and the human body to networks, and by monitoring, operating and controlling them with ultra-small software and a generative AI foundation. It plans to press ahead with spreading the IoT engine 'NEQTO' worldwide, globalizing system management and AI-controlled data control, deploying cloud security SaaS, and commercializing autonomous driving software licensing, while continuing advance investment in research and development and human capital.
entries.ce6e0fcef374c252: It earns revenue from recurring billing centered on monthly fees for management services, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,625 million.

entries.f1f6ab71c02a15d2: A company engaged in the Data Control Business, which automatically monitors and controls servers and IoT devices, providing monthly-fee system operation services and licenses for its IoT engine.
entries.f684f8866b69bb9b: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥418 million.
entries.fa31f74bffec3567: Revenue is generated from a single data control business, and system management is currently the main business. In the IoT field, it is advancing the provision of AI dashboards through its North American subsidiary and partnerships with US companies, and in autopilot for construction machinery it aims to realize an industry-standard machine through a joint project with Sakai Heavy Industries, Ltd.
